scope: Dashboard API/UI error taxonomy: HTTP status classes, transport failures, retry semantics, and fail-closed rendering without masked success.

contracts.httpErrorBody: Non-2xx JSON responses expose string error (+ optional code). Client throws ApiError; never treats as success.
contracts.transport: fetch failures map to ApiError kind offline|timeout|network with status 0 and stable codes; pending mutation idempotency keys are retained.
contracts.timeout: Central client enforces API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS via AbortController; abort surfaces as REQUEST_TIMEOUT.
contracts.retry: retryable=true only for offline/timeout/network/429/5xx; 400/401/403/404/409 are not auto-retry classes.
contracts.serverBoundary: Express final error handler never sends 2xx; headersSent short-circuit; 5xx body is generic INTERNAL_ERROR without stack leak.
contracts.ui: Surfaces must show toast or inline alert on failure; clearing privileged snapshots on error is preferred over stale success data.
contracts.noMask: Partial provider failures and 503 unavailable actions remain non-success (see Stage 27 incident fail-closed).
